text: 查理垂下目光，就像你质疑她的迷信时常有的表现。她说话时带着一种气声，仿佛绝非人类喉咙能发出。“教授，你总是那么相信自己的科学。可我见过伟大的风行者。看吧。”她指向自己的脚。
你低头一看，差点把步枪掉在地上。她的小腿已经变成腐蚀发黑、布满发光裂纹的残桩，脚上长着令人作呕的蹄子。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 208
text: Charlie drops her eyes, as she sometimes did when you challenged her superstitions. She speaks with a breathy overtone, something no human throat could produce. “You are always so certain of your science, Professor. But I have been with the Great Wind-Walker. Look.” She points to her feet.
You glance down and nearly drop your rifle. Her lower legs are blackened, corroded stumps with glowing cracks, and repulsive hooves instead of feet.
